summary: Turns the FM-1 into a USB audio interface and Bluetooth audio receiver with an EQ, limiter, mixer and visualizers. It is not an instrument.
features: Bluetooth receiver with SBC, AAC, aptX, aptX HD and LDAC
Five-band parametric EQ and peak limiter, 8 presets each
Mixer with mute and solo; audio can loop back to USB
Install needs a separate bootloader flashed with M-Flasher first
